title: Word Formation: Suffixes
note: Rewrite 2026-08-30 from Spec_Word-Formation-Suffixes_B1. Core 8: -er/-or, -tion, -ment, -ness, -ful, -less, -able, -ly. Match = suffix→job (tion/ment/ness share noun-maker). Quiz 12 · Type 12 FCE clozes · Use 12 error-correction (E7). · 2026-09-05 B1 loop: the 12 Choose-the-form items each offered three options — the answer and two class traps — so the half of the house style James set after smoking this pack (2026-08-18: answer + one class trap + two by-ear misspellings, because spelling is what the exam grades) was missing, and verify_pack had been warning on all twelve. Each item now keeps the class trap that teaches something (teaching / careful / useful / informative / action / comfortably / management / happily / easy) and swaps the second trap for two misspellings a Czech learner actually writes (teachor · techer, improvment · inprovement, carefuly · carfully, acter · actour, comfortible · confortable, happyness · happines, easyly · easely). That also takes *kinder*, *happier* and *easier* off word-formation chips, which is the fault G5 was written from.
use_hint: Fix the sentence · Enter = check · Enter = next

cards.title: Word Formation: Suffixes
points: A **suffix** is an ending that changes the word's job.
A prefix changes meaning. This lesson is suffixes.

cards.title: Noun makers 1: -er / -or
points: The person or thing that does the action.

cards.title: Noun makers 2: -tion / -ment
points: These make nouns for actions and results.

cards.title: Noun maker 3: -ness
points: A quality, made from an adjective.
